<function name="FindModelByValue" parent="PropSelect" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Find a <page>SpawnIcon</page> panel based on the input model path.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2024.09.02</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="mdl" type="string">The model to find within this <page>PropSelect</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="SpawnIcon">The found spawnicon, or `nil`.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
